SECOND BRAKE DISASSEMBLY

1. CHECK SECOND BRAKE PISTON MOVEMENT
Make sure the second brake piston moves smoothly while
applying and releasing low-pressure compressed air to
the second brake drum.

D4869        705216

2. REMOVE PISTON RETURN SPRING
(a) Places SST on the spring retainer, and compress the re-
turn spring with a shop press.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07040)
(b) Using SST, remove the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07070)
